_why: Round 7, from Destin's review-6 AR6-1: Layout section below Themes; the Framed layout picture redrawn as a full frame. Whole-panel pictures have the popup's height cap lifted in the screenshot only.
title: Appearance panel — round 7: themes first, and a proper Framed picture

steps.headline: Themes now come first, with Layout and Additional Customizations below them.
steps.changed: The Themes box moved to the top of the panel. Layout, with the Additional Customizations box under it, follows, then Effects & chat.
steps.notice: The first thing you see when the panel opens is your themes.

steps.headline: The Framed picture now shows one frame all the way around, with the chat set inside it.
steps.changed: It used to be four separate strips, which read as two bars. Now the whole window is the frame colour, with the chat sitting inside as a rounded pane with an outline, and the message box in the frame below it, as in the real Framed layout.
steps.notice: Auto shows the same picture whenever the theme's own layout is Framed.
